criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
Cache construction returns an error (never panics) for a Shards value that is not a power of two and for negative MaxEntrySize, MaxEntriesInWindow, or HardMaxCacheSize.
Construction returns an error when CleanWindow > 0 but LifeWindow rounds down to 0 seconds, yet does NOT reject a sub-second LifeWindow when CleanWindow is 0.
A nil Hasher in the config is replaced with the default FNV64 hasher so construction still succeeds.
When CleanWindow > 0 a background cleanup goroutine runs on a ticker and reliably terminates on both context cancellation and cache close, without leaking.
criteria.contract_ref: Cache construction & validation / Known pitfalls: Double close

criteria.text: Time-based expiry treats an entry as expired only when current timestamp minus stored timestamp exceeds the life window, and returns not-expired (no unsigned underflow) when current precedes stored; comparisons use second resolution.
criteria.contract_ref: Known pitfalls: Eviction ordering / Life window unit

criteria.text: The onRemove handler is selected with correct precedence (metadata callback, then plain OnRemove, then OnRemoveWithReason, else no-op), and the reason-based callback honors the onRemoveFilter bitmask.
criteria.contract_ref: Eviction & callbacks / Known pitfalls: OnRemove unwrapping cost
